units.source_text: 看到我不知所措的樣子，常子也站起身，瞅了一眼我的錢包說：「唉？就只有這些？」

en.t: Seeing me at a loss, Tsuneko stood up too, glanced into my wallet, and said, “Oh? Is that all?”

units.source_text: 常子有口無心的這句話，卻讓我感到錐心刺骨的疼痛。

en.t: Tsuneko’s careless words pierced me with a pain that seemed to cut to the bone.

units.source_text: 這是我第一次為自己戀人的聲音感到心痛。

en.t: It was the first time I had ever felt hurt by the voice of someone I loved.

units.source_text: 這不是錢多錢少的問題，三塊銅幣根本就不算什麼錢，

en.t: It was not a question of whether the money was much or little; three copper coins were hardly money at all,

units.source_text: 卻使我蒙受了從未有過的奇恥大辱，一種再也沒法活下去的屈辱感。

en.t: yet it made me suffer an unprecedented, unbearable humiliation, the kind that made life itself impossible.

units.source_text: 畢竟那時的我還未能徹底擺脫闊少爺這種屬性吧。

en.t: After all, I suppose I had still not completely shaken off the nature of a spoiled rich boy.

units.source_text: 從那時起，我才真正下定了去死的決心。

en.t: From that moment on, I truly resolved to die.

units.source_text: 那天夜晚，我們倆一起跳進了鎌倉的大海。

en.t: That night, the two of us jumped together into the sea at Kamakura.

units.source_text: 「這條腰帶還是從咖啡館的朋友那裡借來的呢。」

en.t: “I even borrowed this sash from a friend at the café.”
